mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate sustained low-rate monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns in a t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% signals labor market weakness that reduces corporate earnings visibility and increases risk aversion, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns in a t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO > 105) coupled with a falling unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5.0%) signals robust economic expansion that supports strong corporate earnings and reduces risk premiums, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 105 and UNRATE < 5.0% (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns in a t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: High consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%) signals an impending Federal Reserve monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as higher interest rates reduce equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY inflation > 2.5% (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns in a t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 thousand units signals weakening residential construction activity that dampens economic growth and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1200 (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns in a t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO > 105) coupled with high consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.0%) signals an overheating economy that triggers Federal Reserve monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 105 and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.0% (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns in a t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market conditions (PAYEMS > 140000 thousand) signal robust employment growth that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 140000 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns in a t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: Residential investment demand (RSAFS) above 440000 million dollars signals strong economic activity that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 440000 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns in a t-test against zero).
